heading: Service and support
intro: Every product we distribute is supported in Lebanon, from the first sale to the last repair.

points.title: Local repairs
points.text: Our technicians repair products here, without sending them abroad.

points.title: Original spare parts
points.text: We source genuine parts directly from the manufacturer when they are needed.

points.title: Manufacturer warranty
points.text: Warranty follows each manufacturer’s own policy, handled locally by us.
